scope: Third original direction study: local cooperative platform traversal and collision-driven level authoring, with freezing/rescue and reusable level files. Prior factory, park, local cooperation prototype and single-character creator all retained.
reference_basis: DDNet official overview connects cooperation through custom maps, authoring, ranks and tournaments. This sample explores local rescue and level-file sharing, and does not implement that project's full physics, online play or community services.
visual_method: Actual production Canvas2D module and simulation, rendered via Skia. This is not a browser screenshot or HTML/CSS render.
visual_review: Cool alpine mountain scene, amber lights and slate/brass mechanism art distinguish this side-on action direction from the factory and isometric park.
Transparent asset atlas crops remove empty margins around physical stone platforms; all original generated image files are preserved unchanged.
Two adult explorer characters have standing, alternating running and airborne frames, runtime facing reversal and state-driven freeze overlay.
Frozen player and rescue prompt are visible in the first scene; open gate translucency and remaining latch time correspond to actual mechanism state.
Neighboring player labels are vertically separated to avoid overlapping; editor grid and material cursor show the exact collision layout used for play.
